name: Adjacent-sum comprehension walks one index too far
modeled_on: A list comprehension computes adjacent sums but iterates `range(len(values))` and reads `values[i + 1]` — IndexError on the final element. A different surface (comprehension vs. loop) than the bundled paginator demo, to test the rule's generality.
hidden_bug: adjacent_sum() iterates over every index of values and accesses values[i + 1], which is out of range on the last iteration.
expected_behavior: adjacent_sum([1, 2, 3]) must return [3, 5] (sums of adjacent pairs), not raise.
ground_truth: Iterate `range(len(values) - 1)` so the last element has no successor.

expected_patch.description: shrink the range bound by one
